stories.title: Russia-Aligned Hackers Use GuardBreaker Prompt Injection to Disrupt AI Malware Analysis
stories.description: GuardBreaker hides malicious prompts in script comments to trick AI code scanners into bypassing safety checks and deploying malware.

stories.title: Claude Used to Automate Exploitation and Data Theft Across Multiple Victims
stories.description: Anthropic says threat actors used Claude in autonomous cyber operations, including reconnaissance, exploitation, and data theft.

stories.title: New KATARU IoT Malware Packs Linux Privilege Escalation Exploits and Mirai-Style DDoS Attacks
stories.description: KATARU IoT malware exploits weak Telnet passwords to turn devices into persistent DDoS bots, targeting poorly secured systems.

stories.title: Russian State-Sponsored Hackers Use Claude to Rebuild Malware After Detection
stories.description: Anthropic disrupted GTG-20006, a Russian state-sponsored actor that used Claude to rebuild malware after security products detected it.

stories.title: Hackers Impersonate CEOs in 1 Million Emails to Trick Employees Into $50,000 Payments
stories.description: Hackers sent over 1 million fake CEO emails and invoices, tricking employees into approving ACH payments to criminal accounts.

stories.title: Windows 11 Security Update KB5124008 Breaks Always-On VPN Connections
stories.description: Microsoft’s September 2026 security update KB5124008 is knocking some Windows 11 enterprise clients off Always On VPN after the Patch Tuesday package landed on September 8.

stories.title: Trezor Says 347,000 Users Received Phishing Emails After Brevo Hack
stories.description: Hackers compromised the Brevo marketing platform and used that access to send phishing emails to users of Trezor, BitBox, and CoinTracking.

stories.title: Your Critical Vulnerabilities Might Not Be Your Biggest Risk

stories.title: Ukrainian Conti Ransomware Developer Sentenced to 4 Years in US Prison
stories.description: Oleksii Oleksiyovych Lytvynenko has been sentenced to 4 years in prison after he was arrested in Ireland in 2023.

stories.title: Attackers Chain JFrog Artifactory Flaws to Gain Admin Control and Plant Backdoors
stories.description: Attackers chained two JFrog Artifactory flaws on unupdated servers to gain admin control, while a third flaw was exploited separately.
